digo_source: Mgombato ('mnazi coconut tree'; 'nazi coconut'); ICRAF ('Digo: Mnazi'); Pakia 2005

teaser.en: The Digo have a name for every stage of a coconut, from the tiny *kolokotsi* to the overripe *nguta*: seven in all.
teaser.sw: Wadigo wana jina kwa kila hatua ya nazi, kuanzia *kolokotsi* ndogo kabisa hadi *nguta* iliyokomaa kupita kiasi: majina saba kwa jumla.
teaser.dg: Adigo ana dzina kpwa chila hatua ya kukula kpwa nazi, kula *kolokotsi* ndide hadi *nguta* iriyoivwa kutsupa chiasi: madzina sabaa gosi.

summary.en: *Mnazi*, the coconut palm, grows on almost every Digo homestead and is the backbone of coastal cooking, building and income. Kwale and Kilifi hold most of Kenya's coconut trees, and from milk to thatch to palm wine, few plants matter more to Digo life.
summary.sw: *Mnazi* hustawi karibu katika kila boma la Wadigo, na ndio uti wa mgongo wa mapishi, ujenzi na kipato cha pwani. Kaunti za Kwale na Kilifi zina minazi mingi zaidi nchini Kenya, na kuanzia tui hadi makuti hadi tembo, ni mimea michache yenye umuhimu zaidi katika maisha ya Wadigo.
summary.dg: *Mnazi* ni muhi wa nazi. Unamera phephi kpwa chila mudzi wa Adigo, na ndio msingi wa kujita, kudzenga na mapato ga pwani. Kaunti za Kwale na Kilifi ndizo zenye unji wa minazi ya Kenya, na kula huwi hadi makuti hadi uchi, ni mimea michache iriyo na samani zaidi kpwa maisha ga Adigo.

about.en:
*Mnazi* is a tall, slender palm, up to 20 metres, with a single trunk that often leans or curves, topped by a crown of long feathery fronds. The fruits hang in bunches below the leaves, and the Digo have a name for each stage of their growth. Pakia records seven: *kolokotsi*, *tale*, *daka*, *dafu* (the young drinking nut), *koroma*, *nazi* (the mature nut) and *nguta* (overripe).

Pakia also records three Digo kinds of coconut palm, told apart by the colour of their nuts: *mnazi mwiru*, dark green; *mnazi wa kundu*, orange; and *mnazi wa chisamli*, yellow.
about.sw:
*Mnazi* ni mchikichi mrefu na mwembamba, unaofikia hadi mita 20, wenye shina moja ambalo mara nyingi huinama au kupinda, na juu yake kuna taji la makuti marefu yanayofanana na manyoya. Matunda huning'inia kwa vishada chini ya majani, na Wadigo wana jina kwa kila hatua ya ukuaji wake. Pakia anaorodhesha saba: *kolokotsi*, *tale*, *daka*, *dafu* (nazi changa ya kunywa), *koroma*, *nazi* (nazi iliyokomaa) na *nguta* (iliyokomaa kupita kiasi).

Pakia pia anaorodhesha aina tatu za minazi kwa Kidigo, zinazotofautishwa kwa rangi ya nazi zake: *mnazi mwiru*, wa kijani kibichi kilichokolea; *mnazi wa kundu*, wa rangi ya machungwa; na *mnazi wa chisamli*, wa manjano.
about.dg:
*Mnazi* ni muhi mure na mwembamba, unaofika hadi mita 20. Una kolo rimwenga ambaro kpwa kawaida rinabeduka au rinaotyoka, na dzulu ya kolo kuna chitswa cha makuti mare ganagoonekana dza manyoya. Matunda ganabwadzika kpwa mabunda photsi ya makuti, na Adigo ana dzina kpwa chila hatua ya kukula kpwa nazi. Pakia anaandika madzina sabaa: *kolokotsi*, *tale*, *daka*, *dafu* (nazi tsanga ya kunwa), *koroma*, *nazi* (nazi iriyoivwa) na *nguta* (iriyoivwa kutsupa chiasi).

Pakia piya anaandika aina hahu za Chidigo za mnazi, zinazotafwautishwa kpwa rangi ya nazi zao: *mnazi mwiru*, wa chijani iriyo phephi na nyiru; *mnazi wa kundu*, wa rangi ya chungbwa; na *mnazi wa chisamli*, wa rangi ya mandano.

where.en: Coconut palms grow on almost every Digo homestead and in groves inland of Diani and Msambweni. Kwale and Kilifi counties hold most of Kenya's coconut trees, and the palm-lined coast is the signature of Digo country.
where.sw: Minazi hustawi karibu katika kila boma la Wadigo na katika mashamba ya minazi yaliyo bara kutoka Diani na Msambweni. Kaunti za Kwale na Kilifi zina minazi mingi zaidi nchini Kenya, na pwani iliyopambwa kwa minazi ndiyo alama kuu ya nchi ya Wadigo.
where.dg: Minazi inamera phephi kpwa chila mudzi wa Adigo, na kpwenye virirwa vya minazi uphande wa bara wa Diani na Msambweni. Kaunti za Kwale na Kilifi ndizo zenye unji wa minazi ya Kenya, na pwani iriyodzala minazi ndiyo alama ya tsi ya Adigo.

uses.en:
Coconut is in nearly everything the Digo cook. Grated *nazi* is squeezed through the *chifumbu*, a woven basket strainer, to give *huwi* or *uwi*, coconut milk, which goes into rice, cassava, fish, beans and greens. The leftover dregs are *dindiya*, and grated coconut also makes *kashata*, a coconut sweet. The young *dafu* is drunk straight from the nut.

The palm is also tapped for palm wine, *uchi* or *tembo*. The tapper, the *mjema*, climbs to the crown and taps the *phalanga* to collect the sap.

Almost nothing goes to waste. Fronds (*kuti*, plural *makuti*) are used for thatch, and woven fronds are *makandza*. Leaves are made into *hundu* baskets, strips of *mkpwuna* serve as twine, coir is twisted into *ndifu* rope, and the shells, *chivo*, become ladles and fuel. The trunk is used as timber. Coconuts and their products are a major source of income on the coast.
uses.sw:
Nazi imo karibu katika kila chakula kinachopikwa na Wadigo. *Nazi* iliyokunwa hukamuliwa kupitia *chifumbu*, kichujio cha kikapu kilichofumwa, ili kupata *huwi* au *uwi*, yaani tui, linalotiwa katika wali, muhogo, samaki, maharagwe na mboga za majani. Machicha yanayobaki huitwa *dindiya*, na nazi iliyokunwa pia hutengeneza *kashata*, peremende ya nazi. *Dafu* changa hunywewa moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye nazi.

Mnazi pia hugemwa ili kupata tembo, *uchi* au *tembo*. Mgemaji, *mjema*, hupanda hadi kileleni na kugema *phalanga* ili kukusanya utomvu.

Karibu hakuna kinachopotea bure. Makuti (*kuti*, wingi *makuti*) hutumika kuezekea, na makuti yaliyosukwa huitwa *makandza*. Majani hutengenezwa vikapu vya *hundu*, vipande vya *mkpwuna* hutumika kama kamba nyembamba, makumbi husokotwa kuwa kamba ya *ndifu*, na vifuu, *chivo*, huwa kata na kuni. Shina hutumika kama mbao. Nazi na bidhaa zake ni chanzo kikubwa cha kipato pwani.
uses.dg:
Nazi inainjira phephi kpwa chila chakurya Adigo anachojita. *Nazi* iriyokunwa nkutsudzwa kpwa *chifumbu*, kaphu iriyosukwa ya kutsudzira, ili kuphaha *huwi* au *uwi*, maziya ga nazi. Huwi nkutiywa kpwa wari, manga, ng'onda, maharagbwe na mtsunga. Garigosala ni *dindiya*, na nazi iriyokunwa piya nkuhendwa *kashata*, peremende ya nazi. *Dafu*, nazi tsanga, nkunwewa kula ndani ya nazi yenye.

Mnazi piya nkujemwa ili kuphaha uchi wa mnazi, *uchi* au *tembo*. Mutu anayejema, *mjema*, anakpwera hadi dzulu ya mnazi na kujema *phalanga* ili kuphaha madzi ga mnazi.

Phephi takuna chitu chinachotsuphwa. Makuti (*kuti*, wingi *makuti*) nkuhumirwa kuezekera nyumba, na makuti garigosukwa ni *makandza*. Makodza nkuhendwa kaphu za *hundu*, vipande vya *mkpwuna* nkuhumirwa dza lugbwe, *ndifu* nkusokotwa kukala kamba, na vivo, *chivo*, nkuhendwa maliphazi na kuni. Kolo nkuhumirwa dza mbao. Nazi na vitu vinavyohendwa kula kpwa nazi ni njira kulu ya mapato pwani.

culture.en: The Mgombato dictionary records two proverbs. *Mnazi mmwenga una uchi wani?* asks 'How much palm wine can you get from one palm tree?' *Mnazi wa mchetu taujemwa na ndaro* says 'Your wife's coconut palm is not tapped joyfully', because it still belongs to her. Palm wine is woven into coastal social life, and in a mostly Muslim community it is also a lived tension.
culture.sw: Kamusi ya Mgombato inarekodi methali mbili. *Mnazi mmwenga una uchi wani?* inauliza 'Mnazi mmoja una tembo kiasi gani?' *Mnazi wa mchetu taujemwa na ndaro* inasema 'Mnazi wa mkeo haugemwi kwa furaha', kwa sababu bado ni mali yake. Tembo limefungamana na maisha ya kijamii ya pwani, na katika jamii ambayo kwa kiasi kikubwa ni ya Waislamu, pia ni mvutano unaoishi ndani ya maisha ya kila siku.
culture.dg: Kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika ndarira mbiri. *Mnazi mmwenga una uchi wani?* inauza: 'Mnazi mmwenga unaweza kulavya uchi unji wani?' *Mnazi wa mchetu taujemwa na ndaro* inagomba kukala mnazi wa mcheo taujemwa kpwa raha, kpwa sababu bado ni wakpwe. Uchi wa mnazi ni seemu ya maisha ga atu a pwani, na kpwa jamii ambayo unji wa atu ni Aislamu, piya ni dzambo ra mvwehano wa chila siku.

names.en: The Digo name is *mnazi*, and the nut is *nazi*; both are shared with Swahili and Giriama. The names are recorded in the Mgombato dictionary, the ICRAF handbook and Pakia. In English it is the coconut palm, and its scientific name is *Cocos nucifera*, from *nucifera*, 'nut-bearing'.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mnazi*, na tunda ni *nazi*; majina yote mawili yanatumika pia katika Kiswahili na Kigiriama. Majina haya yamerekodiwa katika kamusi ya Mgombato, kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF na Pakia. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *coconut palm*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Cocos nucifera*, kutoka *nucifera*, 'unaozaa kokwa'.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mnazi*, na tunda ni *nazi*; madzina gosi mairi ni sawa na ga Chiswahili na Chigiryama. Madzina higa ganaphahikana kpwenye kamusi ya Mgombato, chitabu cha ICRAF na Pakia. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *coconut palm*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Cocos nucifera*, kula *nucifera*, 'unaolavya nazi'.

conservation.en: Groves have been lost to titanium mining, and many trees are ageing; replanting programmes aim to renew them.
conservation.sw: Mashamba ya minazi yamepotea kutokana na uchimbaji wa titani, na minazi mingi imezeeka; miradi ya kupanda upya inalenga kuifufua.
conservation.dg: Virirwa vya minazi vikaangamika kpwa sababu ya kutsimba madini ga titanium, na minazi minji ikakala ya kare; mipango ya kuphanda minazi miphya inalonda kuika uphya virirwa vino.

reason.en: Another palm tapped for palm wine
reason.sw: Mchikichi mwingine unaogemwa ili kupata tembo
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa aina ya mnazi unaojemwa kpwa uchi

reason.en: Also tapped for palm wine and used for thatch and weaving
reason.sw: Pia hugemwa ili kupata tembo na hutumika kuezekea na kusuka
reason.dg: Piya nkujemwa kpwa uchi na nkuhumirwa kuezekera nyumba na kusuka

reason.en: Rice is cooked in coconut milk
reason.sw: Wali hupikwa kwa tui la nazi

reason.en: Cassava is cooked in coconut milk
reason.sw: Muhogo hupikwa kwa tui la nazi

reason.en: Cashew, the other great tree cash crop of the coast
reason.sw: Mkorosho, zao jingine kuu la biashara la miti pwani
reason.dg: M'bibo, muhi wanjina mkulu wa mapato wa pwani

definition.en: The leaf of the coconut palm. Leaves in general are makodza, but the coconut leaf has its own name; kuti is used less for other feather-leaved palms (Phoenix, Raphia) and never for cycads. Mgombato also uses kuti for roofing thatch made from palm leaves.
definition.sw: Jani la mnazi. Majani kwa jumla huitwa makodza, lakini jani la mnazi lina jina lake maalum; kuti halitumiki sana kwa michikichi mingine yenye majani kama manyoya (Phoenix, Raphia) na kamwe halitumiki kwa mimea ya jamii ya cycad. Mgombato pia hutumia kuti kwa makuti ya kuezekea yanayotengenezwa kwa majani ya michikichi.
definition.dg: Kodza ra mnazi. Makodza kpwa ujumla ni *makodza*, ela kodza ra mnazi rina dzina ra chipekee; *kuti* nkuhumirwa chidide kpwa mihi yanjina ya aina ya mnazi yenye makodza dza manyoya (*Phoenix*, *Raphia*), na tarihumirwa kabisa kpwa cycads. Mgombato piya inahumira *kuti* kpwa makuti ga kuezekera garigohendwa kula makodza ga mihi ya aina ya mnazi.

use.en: Plaited roofing (vyungo), woven mats (kandza) and brooms (liphyero) are made from it; Pakia says those made from other palms are of poorer quality.
use.sw: Hutengenezwa makuti ya kuezekea yaliyosukwa (vyungo), mikeka iliyofumwa (kandza) na fagio (liphyero); Pakia anasema vile vinavyotengenezwa kwa michikichi mingine huwa duni zaidi.
use.dg: Kuti nkusukwa kuhenda *vyungo* vya kuezekera, *kandza* (majamvi) na *liphyero*; Pakia anagomba kukala vitu vinavyohendwa kula mihi yanjina ya aina ya mnazi si vinono dza vino.

definition.en: The woody midrib that runs the length of the coconut leaf. Mgombato spells it bati (class ma): 'wooden stem of palm leaf'.
definition.sw: Ubavu mgumu wa mbao unaopita urefu wote wa jani la mnazi. Mgombato anaiandika bati (ngeli ya ma): 'shina la mbao la jani la mchikichi'.
definition.dg: Mongo mufu wa kodza ra mnazi, unaotsupa kula mwandzo hadi mwisho wa kodza. Mgombato inauandika *bati* (*ma*): 'mongo wa muhi wa kodza ra mnazi'.

use.en: Used to make vyungo (fronds are tied back onto it to make thatch) and mbano, sticks for smoking fish.
use.sw: Hutumika kutengeneza vyungo (majani hufungwa tena juu yake ili kutengeneza makuti) na mbano, vijiti vya kubanikia samaki.
use.dg: Nkuhumirwa kuhenda *vyungo* (makodza nkufungwa luphya dzuluye kuhenda makuti ga kuezekera) na *mbano*, mihi midide ya kuwadira ng'onda.

definition.en: The thick stalk at the base of the coconut leaf, where it joins the trunk. Mgombato describes it as the part of the branch nearest the trunk.
definition.sw: Ngozi ya nje ya tunda la nazi. Neno hilohilo hutaja kitako cha kikonyo cha jani.
definition.dg: Gada ra kondze ra nazi. Neno hiri piya ni dzina ra kolo ra mlita wa kodza.

use.en: Burned as firewood, especially by commercial food vendors; Mgombato adds that it is often used as an improvised seat.

shared_with: kumbi: the outer skin of the coconut fruit

definition.en: The leaflets of the coconut leaf, the long narrow blades along the midrib. Pakia says makalala and mikalala are interchangeable.
definition.sw: Vijani vya jani la mnazi, yaani vipande virefu vyembamba vilivyo kando ya ubavu. Pakia anasema makalala na mikalala hutumika kwa kubadilishana.
definition.dg: Makodza madide ga kodza ra mnazi, vipande virefu vyembamba vinavyokala kanda-kanda ya mongo wa kodza. Pakia anagomba kukala *makalala* na *mikalala* ni dzambo mwenga.

meaning.en: Probably named after the rustling noise the leaflets make in the wind.
meaning.sw: Huenda yameitwa hivyo kutokana na mchakacho unaotolewa na vijani hivyo upepo unapovuma.
meaning.dg: Labuda ganaihwa kpwa kululu ganarohenda makodza gaga ganaphopigwa ni phepho.

definition.en: The thin midrib of each coconut leaflet. When the word is used for another palm a phrase is added, as in ukuti wa uchindu, which shows the coconut is the model for these names.
definition.sw: Ubavu mwembamba wa kila kijani cha jani la mnazi. Neno hili linapotumika kwa mchikichi mwingine huongezewa maneno, kama katika ukuti wa uchindu, jambo linaloonyesha kwamba mnazi ndio kielelezo cha majina haya.
definition.dg: Mongo mwembamba wa chila kodza dide ra mnazi. Neno hiri richihumirwa kpwa muhi wanjina wa aina ya mnazi nkuenjerezwa neno, dza *ukuti wa uchindu*, na hino inaonyesa kukala mnazi ndio chielelezo cha madzina higa.

use.en: Bundled into brooms (liphyero) and made into fish traps (tsatsa).
use.sw: Hufungwa pamoja kutengeneza fagio (liphyero) na hutengenezwa mitego ya samaki (tsatsa).
use.dg: Nkufungwa phamwenga kuhenda maliphyero (*liphyero*) na nkuhendwa mihambo ya ng'onda (*tsatsa*).

definition.en: One frond (leaflet) of a palm leaf. Mgombato gives its plural as kuti and its Swahili as ukuti; it may be related to Pakia's ukuti, which Pakia defines as the leaflet's midrib.
definition.sw: Kijani kimoja cha jani la mchikichi. Mgombato anatoa wingi wake kuwa kuti na Kiswahili chake kuwa ukuti; huenda linahusiana na ukuti wa Pakia, ambao Pakia anaufafanua kama ubavu wa kijani.
definition.dg: Kodza dide rimwenga ra kodza ra muhi wa aina ya mnazi. Mgombato inapha wingiwe dza *kuti* na Chiswahili *ukuti*; labuda rinahusiana na *ukuti* wa Pakia, ambaye anaugomba kukala ni mongo wa kodza dide.

definition.en: The fibrous material on the coconut leaf stalk; Mgombato describes it as the fibres that hold a frond to the palm. The same word names the coir of the fruit.
definition.sw: Makumbi, yaani tabaka la nyuzinyuzi la ganda la nazi. Neno hilohilo hutaja nyuzi zilizo kwenye kikonyo cha jani.
definition.dg: Nyuzi za rifu ra nazi. Neno hiri piya ni dzina ra nyuzi ziriphokala kpwa mlita wa kodza.

use.en: Used as a sieve, especially when tapping palm sap.
use.sw: Kumbi hutumika kusugulia vyombo, kama sufu ya chuma; hivi karibuni zaidi hutengenezwa vitambaa vya kusafishia sakafu na husindikwa kuwa coco-peat kwa udongo wa kupandia mimea vyunguni.
use.dg: Ndifu nkuhumirwa kusingira vyombo, dza sufu ya chuma; sambi piya nkuhendwa vitambara vya kusingira photsi na nkuhendwa coco-peat ya kuphandira mimea kpwa vyombo.

shared_with: ndifu: the coir (fibrous husk) of the coconut fruit

definition.en: A coconut frond, and a mat woven from one. Mgombato also lists likandza (plural makandza), a woven palm frond used as a mat.
definition.sw: Jani la mnazi, na pia mkeka uliofumwa kwa jani hilo. Mgombato pia anaorodhesha likandza (wingi makandza), jani la mchikichi lililofumwa linalotumika kama mkeka.
definition.dg: Kodza ra mnazi, na jamvi rinarosukwa kula kpwa kodza hiro. Mgombato piya inaandika *likandza* (wingi *makandza*), kodza ra mnazi rirorosukwa rinarohumirwa dza jamvi.

definition.en: The tender, edible part at the top of the coconut palm (or raffia palm) between the stem and the leaves.
definition.sw: Sehemu laini inayolika iliyo juu ya mnazi (au mwale) kati ya shina na majani.
definition.dg: Seemu ya yuya inayoriwa iriyo dzulu ya mnazi (au ya mtsikitsi), kahi ya kolo na makodza.

definition.en: The flowering branch of the coconut palm, the part that develops into coconuts.
definition.sw: Tawi la maua la mnazi, sehemu inayokua na kuwa nazi.
definition.dg: Panda ra maruwa ra mnazi, seemu inayokula hadi ikakala nazi.

meaning.en: The word also means 'to sow'; Pakia found no clear link between the two.
meaning.sw: Neno hili pia lina maana ya 'kupanda mbegu'; Pakia hakupata uhusiano wa wazi kati ya maana hizi mbili.
meaning.dg: Neno hiri piya ni 'kuphanda' (mbeyu); Pakia kaphaha uhusiano wazi kahi ya mana mairi higa.

definition.en: The small flowers (florets) on the coconut flower branch. In Pakia's sequence the fruit develops from punga, before the kolokotsi stage.
definition.sw: Maua madogo (vijua) yaliyo kwenye tawi la maua la mnazi. Katika mfuatano wa Pakia, tunda hukua kutoka punga, kabla ya hatua ya kolokotsi.
definition.dg: Maruwa madide ganagokala kpwa panda ya maruwa ya mnazi. Kpwa mpangilio wa Pakia, tunda rinakula kula kpwa *punga*, kabla ya hatua ya *kolokotsi*.

meaning.en: Named for their likeness to the rice panicle, mphunga.
meaning.sw: Yameitwa hivyo kwa kufanana na shuke la mpunga, mphunga.
meaning.dg: Ganaihwa hivyo kpwa sababu ganahalana na punga ra *mphunga*.

shared_with: punga: the male tassel of maize
punga: the flowering panicles of grasses and sugarcane

definition.en: The stalks of the coconut flower branch that carry the fruits. Mgombato: the part of the palm that holds the coconuts.
definition.sw: Vikonyo vya tawi la maua la mnazi vinavyobeba matunda. Mgombato: sehemu ya mnazi inayoshikilia nazi.
definition.dg: Milita ya panda ya maruwa ya mnazi inayotsukula nazi. Mgombato: seemu ya mnazi inayogbwira nazi.

definition.en: The cover that wraps the coconut flower branch. Mgombato adds that palm wine is tapped from this part.
definition.sw: Ganda linalofunika tawi la maua la mnazi. Mgombato anaongeza kwamba tembo hugemwa kutoka sehemu hii.
definition.dg: Gada rinarofunika panda ya maruwa ya mnazi. Mgombato inaenjereza kukala uchi nkujemwa kula seemu hino.

use.en: Burned as firewood; tapped for palm wine.
use.sw: Huchomwa kama kuni; hugemwa ili kupata tembo.
use.dg: Nkuochwa dza kuni; nkujemwa kpwa uchi.

definition.en: The first stage of the coconut, very small, with no water or flesh inside. Mgombato: little more than a bud and not yet edible.
definition.sw: Hatua ya kwanza ya nazi, ndogo sana, isiyo na maji wala nyama ndani. Mgombato: si zaidi ya kichipukizi na bado hailiki.
definition.dg: Hatua ya kpwanza ya nazi: ndide sana, taina madzi wala nyama ndani. Mgombato: ni dza chimea bahi, na taidzangbwerika.

use.sw: Hutumika kwa shughuli zinazohusiana na uchawi tu.
use.dg: Nkuhumirwa tu kpwa mambo ga utsai.

definition.en: The second stage: still immature and small, but larger than kolokotsi, with hardly any water or flesh.
definition.sw: Hatua ya pili: bado changa na ndogo, lakini kubwa kuliko kolokotsi, na karibu haina maji wala nyama.
definition.dg: Hatua ya phiri: bado taidzangbwekomala na ni ndide, ela ni kulu kuriko *kolokotsi*, na phephi taina madzi wala nyama.

use.en: Also used only for magic-related purposes.
use.sw: Nayo pia hutumika kwa shughuli zinazohusiana na uchawi tu.
use.dg: Piya nkuhumirwa tu kpwa mambo ga utsai.

definition.en: The third stage: still immature but now large, with some water that is not yet sweet and no flesh.
definition.sw: Hatua ya tatu: bado changa lakini sasa ni kubwa, ina maji kiasi ambayo bado si matamu, na haina nyama.
definition.dg: Hatua ya hahu: bado taidzangbweivwa ela sambi ni kulu, ina madzi chidide ambago bado taganadzangbwekala ga mtswano, na taina nyama.

definition.en: The middle stage: the water is sweet and there is a thin layer of soft flesh.
definition.sw: Hatua ya kati: maji ni matamu na kuna tabaka jembamba la nyama laini.
definition.dg: Hatua ya kahi: madzi ni ga mtswano na kuna nyama nyembamba ya yuya.

definition.en: The stage between dafu and nazi: the water is no longer sweet and the flesh is too hard to enjoy fresh, but still too soft to make coconut milk (uwi).
definition.sw: Hatua iliyo kati ya dafu na nazi: maji si matamu tena na nyama ni ngumu mno kufurahiwa ikiwa mbichi, lakini bado ni laini mno kutengeneza tui (uwi).
definition.dg: Hatua iriyo kahi ya *dafu* na *nazi*: madzi tagana mtswano tsena, na nyama ni ngumu kurika vivyo, ela bado ni ya yuya sana kuhenda huwi (*uwi*).

definition.en: The mature coconut, the most useful stage. Nazi is also the everyday word for any coconut, but strictly it means this stage.
definition.sw: Nyama nyeupe ya nazi, sehemu inayokunwa ili kupata tui.
definition.dg: Nyama nyereru ya nazi, seemu inayokunwa kuhenda huwi.

use.en: Grated to make coconut milk (uwi) for cooking and for making coconut oil; the Digo grow coconut palms mainly for the nazi.

definition.en: A late, over-mature stage that farmers mostly avoid.
definition.sw: Hatua ya mwisho ya nazi iliyokomaa kupita kiasi, ambayo wakulima kwa kawaida huiepuka.
definition.dg: Hatua ya mwisho, nazi iriyoivwa kutsupa chiasi, ambayo akurima anji anaihepa.

use.en: The flesh is chewed and is believed to be an aphrodisiac; it can also be sold as copra for oil.
use.sw: Nyama yake hutafunwa na inaaminika kuongeza nguvu za kiume; pia inaweza kuuzwa kama mbata kwa ajili ya mafuta.
use.dg: Nyamaye nkuafunwa, na nkuaminika kukala inaenjereza hamu ya kulala na mchetu; piya inaweza kuguzwa dza mbata ya kuhenda mafuha.

definition.en: The outer skin of the coconut fruit. The same word names the base of the leaf stalk.
definition.sw: Ngozi ya nje ya tunda la nazi. Neno hilohilo hutaja kitako cha kikonyo cha jani.
definition.dg: Gada ra kondze ra nazi. Neno hiri piya ni dzina ra kolo ra mlita wa kodza.

shared_with: kumbi: the base of the coconut leaf stalk

definition.en: The coir, the fibrous layer of the coconut husk. The same word names the fibres on the leaf stalk.
definition.sw: Makumbi, yaani tabaka la nyuzinyuzi la ganda la nazi. Neno hilohilo hutaja nyuzi zilizo kwenye kikonyo cha jani.
definition.dg: Nyuzi za rifu ra nazi. Neno hiri piya ni dzina ra nyuzi ziriphokala kpwa mlita wa kodza.

use.en: The coir husk is used for scrubbing utensils, like steel wool; more recently it is made into floor rags and processed into coco-peat for potting soil.
use.sw: Kumbi hutumika kusugulia vyombo, kama sufu ya chuma; hivi karibuni zaidi hutengenezwa vitambaa vya kusafishia sakafu na husindikwa kuwa coco-peat kwa udongo wa kupandia mimea vyunguni.
use.dg: Ndifu nkuhumirwa kusingira vyombo, dza sufu ya chuma; sambi piya nkuhendwa vitambara vya kusingira photsi na nkuhendwa coco-peat ya kuphandira mimea kpwa vyombo.

shared_with: ndifu: the fibres on the coconut leaf stalk

definition.en: The husk, the whole outer covering of the coconut.
definition.sw: Ganda, yaani kifuniko chote cha nje cha nazi.
definition.dg: Rifu ra nazi, gada rosi ra kondze rinarofunika nazi.

use.en: Used for firewood, for stuffing mattresses and for making rope.
use.sw: Hutumika kama kuni, kujaza magodoro na kutengeneza kamba.
use.dg: Nkuhumirwa dza kuni, kudzaza magodoro na kuhenda kamba.

definition.en: The hard inner shell of the coconut.
definition.sw: Kifuu kigumu cha ndani cha nazi.
definition.dg: Gada gumu ra ndani ra nazi.

use.en: Used as fuel; Mgombato adds ladles, and Pakia notes it is now also made into bracelets.
use.sw: Hutumika kama nishati ya kuni; Mgombato anaongeza kata, na Pakia anabainisha kwamba sasa pia hutengenezwa bangili.
use.dg: Nkuhumirwa dza kuni; Mgombato inaenjereza maliphazi, na Pakia anagomba kukala sambi piya nkuhendwa bangili.

definition.en: The empty shell of a young coconut (dafu).
definition.sw: Kifuu kitupu cha nazi changa (dafu).
definition.dg: Chivo chitupu cha nazi tsanga (*dafu*).

definition.en: The clear liquid inside the coconut. Pakia stresses that this, not uwi, is what English calls 'coconut water' or sometimes 'coconut milk'.
definition.sw: Kiowevu angavu kilicho ndani ya nazi. Pakia anasisitiza kwamba hiki, wala si uwi, ndicho Kiingereza kinachokiita 'coconut water' au wakati mwingine 'coconut milk'.
definition.dg: Madzi meru ganagokala ndani ya nazi. Pakia anatiya mkazo kukala higa, si *uwi*, ndigo Chingereza ganaihwa 'coconut water' au wakati wanjina 'coconut milk'.

definition.en: The white flesh of the coconut, the part grated for coconut milk.
definition.sw: Nyama nyeupe ya nazi, sehemu inayokunwa ili kupata tui.
definition.dg: Nyama nyereru ya nazi, seemu inayokunwa kuhenda huwi.

shared_with: nazi: the mature stage of the fruit, and the coconut in general

definition.en: The soft, edible flesh of a young drinking coconut (dafu).
definition.sw: Nyama laini inayolika ya nazi changa ya kunywa (dafu).
definition.dg: Nyama ya yuya inayoriwa ya nazi tsanga ya kunwa (*dafu*).

definition.en: The embryo inside the coconut, from which the new palm grows.
definition.sw: Kiinitete kilicho ndani ya nazi, ambacho mnazi mpya huota kutoka kwake.
definition.dg: Chitsa chiriphokala ndani ya nazi, ambacho mnazi muphya unamera kula kpwacho.

meaning.en: Moon; Pakia suggests the round embryo looks like a full moon.
meaning.sw: Mwezi; Pakia anapendekeza kwamba kiinitete hicho cha mviringo kinafanana na mwezi mpevu.
meaning.dg: Mwezi wa dzulu; Pakia anaona kukala chitsa chiri dza mviringo chinahalana na mwezi mzima.

shared_with: mwezi: the cotyledon of the mango seed

definition.en: The three 'eyes' (scars) on the coconut shell; the same word is used for a bean's hilum and a potato's eye buds.
definition.sw: 'Macho' matatu (makovu) yaliyo kwenye kifuu cha nazi; neno hilohilo hutumika kwa kitovu cha harage na vichipukizi vya kiazi.
definition.dg: 'Matso' mahahu (alama) ganagokala kpwa chivo cha nazi; neno hiri piya nkuhumirwa kpwa alama ya tembe ya haragbwe na matso ga chiazi.

definition.en: Coconuts tied together in a bunch.
definition.sw: Nazi zilizofungwa pamoja kwa kishada.
definition.dg: Nazi zirizofungwa phamwenga kpwa bunda.

definition.en: A bunch of coconuts still on their fruit stalks.
definition.sw: Kishada cha nazi ambazo bado ziko kwenye vikonyo vyake.
definition.dg: Bunda ra nazi zichiri kpwa milita yao.

definition.en: Coconut milk: the creamy liquid squeezed from grated mature coconut (nazi). Mgombato spells it huwi and describes straining the grated pulp with water through a chifumbu basket.
definition.sw: Tui: kiowevu kizito kinachokamuliwa kutoka nazi iliyokomaa (nazi) iliyokunwa. Mgombato anaiandika huwi na anaeleza jinsi machicha yaliyokunwa yanavyochujwa pamoja na maji kupitia kikapu cha chifumbu.
definition.dg: Maziya ga nazi: madzi mazito ganagominywa kula nazi iriyoivwa na kukunwa. Mgombato inauandika *huwi* na inaeleza kutsudza nazi iriyokunwa na madzi kpwa kaphu ya *chifumbu*.

use.en: Used for cooking and for making coconut oil.
use.sw: Hutumika kupikia na kutengeneza mafuta ya nazi.
use.dg: Nkuhumirwa kujitira na kuhenda mafuha ga nazi.

definition.en: The coconut left in the shell after grating.
definition.sw: Nazi inayobaki kwenye kifuu baada ya kukuna.
definition.dg: Nazi inayosala ndani ya chivo bada ya kukunwa.

definition.en: Palm wine tapped from the coconut palm.
definition.sw: Tembo linalogemwa kutoka mnazi.
definition.dg: Uchi unaojemwa kula kpwa mnazi.

definition.en: Palm wine; also liquor, beer or any alcoholic drink.
definition.sw: Tembo; pia pombe, bia au kinywaji chochote chenye kileo.
definition.dg: Uchi wa mnazi; piya chinwadzi chochosi chinachomuhenda mutu alewe.

definition.en: A section of thatch made from coconut leaves: leaflets are plucked and tied one by one back onto the midrib (mbati), overlapping so that rain cannot get through.
definition.sw: Kipande cha kuti la kuezekea kinachotengenezwa kwa majani ya mnazi: vijani hung'olewa na kufungwa kimoja kimoja tena kwenye ubavu (mbati), vikipishana ili mvua isipenye.
definition.dg: Chipande cha makuti chirichohendwa kula makodza ga mnazi: makodza madide nkumwafulwa na kufungwa mwenga-mwenga luphya kpwa *mbati*, garigolaliana ili mvula isiinjire.

use.en: Roofing. Mgombato: viungo vya mwenga mwenga is a single layer of thatch, viungo vya mairi mairi a double layer.
use.sw: Kuezekea paa. Mgombato: viungo vya mwenga mwenga ni makuti ya tabaka moja, viungo vya mairi mairi ni ya tabaka mbili.
use.dg: Kuezekera nyumba. Mgombato: *viungo vya mwenga mwenga* ni tabaka mwenga ya makuti, *viungo vya mairi mairi* ni tabaka mbiri.

definition.en: A strip of palm leaf, for example for tying leaves onto a stick to make sections of thatch. Mgombato does not name the palm; its plural ng'ongo is also a separate raffia word.
definition.sw: Kipande chembamba cha jani la mchikichi, kwa mfano cha kufungia majani kwenye kijiti ili kutengeneza vipande vya makuti. Mgombato hautaji mchikichi husika; wingi wake ng'ongo pia ni neno tofauti linalohusu mwale.
definition.dg: Chipande chembamba cha kodza ra muhi wa aina ya mnazi, kpwa mfwano kufungira makodza kpwa muhi kuhenda vipande vya makuti. Mgombato taitaja dzina ra muhi; wingiwe *ng'ongo* piya ni neno ranjina ra mlala.

definition.en: A strip of coconut frond used as string or twine.
definition.sw: Kipande chembamba cha jani la mnazi kinachotumika kama uzi au kamba nyembamba.
definition.dg: Chipande cha kodza ra mnazi chinachohumirwa dza lugbwe au uzi.

definition.en: A broom; Pakia names it among the things made from the leaflet midribs (mikuti).
definition.sw: Fagio; Pakia analitaja miongoni mwa vitu vinavyotengenezwa kwa mbavu za vijani (mikuti).
definition.dg: Phyero; Pakia anaritaja kahi ya vitu vinavyohendwa kula kpwa mingo ya makodza madide (*mikuti*).

definition.en: A fish trap made from the leaflet midribs (mikuti).
definition.sw: Mtego wa samaki unaotengenezwa kwa mbavu za vijani (mikuti).
definition.dg: Muhambo wa ng'onda unaohendwa kula kpwa mingo ya makodza madide (*mikuti*).

definition.en: Sticks for smoking fish, made from the leaf midrib (mbati).
definition.sw: Vijiti vya kubanikia samaki, vinavyotengenezwa kwa ubavu wa jani (mbati).
definition.dg: Mihi midide ya kuwadira ng'onda, inayohendwa kula kpwa mongo wa kodza (*mbati*).

mgombato: mnazi (mi) coconut tree (Cocos nucifera); mnazi. Proverb: Mnazi mmwenga una uchi wani? How much palm wine can you get from one palm tree?; Proverb: Mnazi wa mchetu taujemwa na ndaro. Your wife's coconut palm is not tapped joyfully (because it still belongs to her).
nazi (-) coconut; nazi. (See: chivo, kolokotsi, dafu, koroma, chifumbu, huwi, mbuzi,)
